item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera does a science activity at home in Jaipur. She puts two strips of metal into a lemon and connects them with wires to a small lamp.
Which setup will work as a cell and make the lamp glow?

options.A: two copper strips pushed into the lemon and connected to the lamp
options.B: a copper strip and an iron strip pushed into the lemon and connected to the lamp
options.C: a copper strip and an iron strip placed in a glass of plain water and connected to the lamp
options.D: a copper strip and an iron strip held in the air above the lemon and connected to the lamp
